en: Sepia-toned photograph mounted on a cardboard backing, showing a large rectangular neoclassical building with multiple wings, arched windows on the ground floor, and a central entrance with a small staircase. The structure has flat roofs with balustrades and several low towers. In front there is an open, bare area and some leafless trees, suggesting late autumn or winter. Handwritten text in a cursive script appears on the mount below the image.
